verification.method: live view reads via genlayer-js at the current head
verification.note: GenVM is not an EVM chain, so eth_getCode returns 0x even for a live contract and cannot be used to compare deployed bytecode against source. Deployment is instead evidenced by live view reads answering from this address. The source hash above is the repository revision this record was written against; that the deployed code matches it is established behaviourally, by the binding comparison below, because GenVM exposes no deployed-code read.

state_note: The live address carries the same populated end state as the retired predecessor, reached independently: the contract was deployed empty, and the state-driven agent duet was then run against it without --fresh, driving it through found -> propose -> reject -> adapt -> ratify -> dispute -> CRITICAL_BREACH. The board therefore reads ON-CHAIN (not ON-CHAIN / EMPTY): treaty 1 (Halcyon's loose opening offer, still standing with a 700 GEN bond) makes both enclaves reachable, since the contract has no enclave enumerator and enclaves are discovered only transitively through treaties. Both studio-next.genlayer.com and studio-dev.genlayer.com serve chain 61997 and answer identically; the repository standardises on studio-next, matching the hackathon brief.
